text: A presheaf $F$ on a topological space $X$ is a functor $F:\mathcal{O}(X)^{op}\to\mathbf{Set}$ assigning to each open set $U$ a set $F(U)$ of sections together with restriction maps.
explanation: This is exactly the chapter's definition of a presheaf; the 'op' records that restriction goes from larger opens to smaller ones. A presheaf becomes a sheaf only after additionally imposing the gluing axiom, but that extra condition is not required merely to be a presheaf.
